articles.title: F.N.B. Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Earnings
articles.summary: F.N.B. Corporation has announced record net interest income, attributed to a robust expansion in its net interest margin. articles.title: Where to dance in Amsterdam this week for Amsterdam Dance Event's 30th Anniversary [Event Guide]
articles.summary: The Amsterdam Dance Event (ADE) celebrates its 30th anniversary from October 21-25. This significant electronic music festival will feature over 3,600 artists performing across 1,300 events. The occasion feels like both a grand birthday celebration and, for some, a poignant farewell tour, underscoring its three-decade legacy in the international music scene.

articles.title: Norway data centre firm hunts for partner on Canada-Europe fibre link
articles.summary: Canada is critically reviewing its extensive reliance on U.S. networks for data and voice traffic. Prompted by perceived U.S. threats to Canadian sovereignty, Prime Minister Mark Carney's government is assessing this significant vulnerability in its digital infrastructure. This move underscores growing concerns for national security and digital autonomy, highlighting strategic challenges in international relations with a major ally.

articles.title: Beyond air power: How long-range missiles are reshaping the rules of war
articles.summary: During 'Op Sindoor,' Pakistan reportedly realized a significant strategic gap between conventional warfare and the nuclear threshold. This 'void' implies that conflicts can escalate substantially through conventional means before nuclear options become imminent. Understanding this space is crucial for military strategists in managing conflict and deterring escalation, highlighting complex strategic challenges.

articles.title: She won a beauty pageant in 2017 but chose the Army over an international opportunity; Major Garima Yadav became the first woman Army officer to serve as ADC to the UP Governor
articles.summary: Major Garima Yadav, a 2017 beauty pageant winner, made an inspiring decision to join the Indian Army, choosing it over an international opportunity. She subsequently became the first woman Army officer in a significant, undisclosed capacity. Her journey exemplifies profound dedication and patriotism, serving as a powerful motivator and role model for SSB aspirants considering a challenging yet rewarding career in the armed forces.
